description: Capabilities for the floating-iPhone simulator windows (label simulator-*): drag the frame to move, focus, close, minimize, resize (rotate), render the live session webview, and persist the handed-off API base URL plus session recordings. This grant is NOT minimal any more. The earlier description advertised windowing, webview and events only, and that had quietly stopped being true: SimulatorWindow calls persistBaseUrl (plugin-store) on mount, and when that call is denied authedFetch falls back to localhost:3000 and every control call fails. Nothing caught it because these windows had been deleted; they exist again on Windows and Linux, where there is no separate Simulator app. The grant now mirrors EXACTLY what simulator-app.json already gives the separate app's sim-* windows -- the same view, so the same needs -- and nothing beyond them. The account API key is NOT reachable from here and widening this file cannot change that: secret_save/secret_load/secret_delete are gated in Rust by secret_command_caller_allowed -> is_main_gui_command_caller, which requires the window label to be exactly "main".
